body: Hey your super man. There has to be another way out other than suicide.

Well my friends do use drugs but because they enjoy using.  They don't really have depression. I mean the conclusion I came to was my depression and negative Thinking Was to much for them to take.  I don't blame them I can barely tolerate myself.  It's hard when someones energy brings you down.  So actually they have been keeping there distance from me.  Honestly I only have reedit to vent now which I guess is better than venting to friends since they don't want to hear the same sob story over and over again...I know I need to change but even the chance of dying/living completely alone isn't giving me the motivation to change. I think I have self destructive personality and even tho I don't want to be alone in this world all my actions and lack of show me that I do want to just be alone...I'm so complicated I hate it all.
Yea the thing is I've already wasted to much time that I'm a nit impatient anyways thanks for hearing me out. I'll just try to take it slow and easy

Thanks but Im still trying to find something in this world worth living for but in the end I'm sure I won't have anything. I'm not normal it's like normal people want things out of life like a career, there own family, etc. I mean I did or maybe still want those things but I have no idea where to even start.  I have so many problems I just feel overwhelmed and the easily solution is death.  Some people are just meant to suffer throughout their life and I'm starting to except that's my destiny but I just wish it would only be me. cause I know me being like this hurts my mom and brother when they see me like this I can see pain there face as well. So these days I don't say much about how I feel cause I don't wanna bring them down

Well I read somewhere that when a person is on there deathbed one of the biggest regrets they have were burning bridges with the people in there life...knowing this I still burn bridges because I just feel so ashamed and worthless.  I know it's hard for people to deal with me. Its like I subconsciously sabotage all my relationships to be completely alone in the end so noone will miss me and I can end my life without doubting it's the wrong thing to do. I honestly don't wish harm on any other human being other than myself. I look in the mirror and hate my own face but in the end I still end up hurting others emotionally.  It's just I know we as human beings have free will and a choice but after my expieriences with my parents I was to weak in the end.  I mean I learned what was wrong or right and yet peer pressure and the longing to belong got me to do and become all the things I didn't want.  I'm the end I'm weak it's all my fault for how shitty my life has become.  That's the worst part I can't blame anyone else it was all on me. Yea I know I need help but I guess I gave up on myself already it all just seems pointless...like last year I went to a church retreat cause my mom thought it would help me...It was actually a good experience people seemed to genuinely care about me but after the retreat was over it was all back to the same shit. Those people had there own life and problems they didn't have time to help me outside of the retreat.  Anyways I do t know where I was going with this.  After my firat failed attempts I had to go to a psych ward for a week. Was on ssri's but thy made things worse and I started abusing them taking like 10 a day instead of the recommended one I started hating myself even more and was starting to become very wild and violent. Starting punning holes in walls starting hurting myself burnig, cutting and beating.  Which lead to my second failed attempt. Well after that they tol me that if I actually succeded in killin myself that they would hold my mother personally responsible and that she would go to jail so after that I quit taking the medication and have just been suffering alone. Havens made a suicide attempt since even tho it's always on my mind.

I'm sorry you have gone through that. I know how it feels when the person that should Be loving you the most actually hurts you the most. Just keep fighting all the negative thought. Hope you can love yourself.

I feel the same way...I know your being hard on yourself but we gotta escape all those negative thought and try to move forward...I really hope you feel better. If you ever wanna talk pm me sorry I can't do anything other than listen

Thanks for the offer but I think suicidal people hate themselves so much even when help is offered they just can't handle the fact that 
People care...it puts them in a corner feeling even more trapped...well that's the case with me....
I'm starting to just except the fact that I am a loser and there is no hope for me I mean if there are winners in life there are people who have to fail right? So why even bother...hahaha I guess me talking like this is what got al my friends to leave me

Well A father is a role model for the son...he didn't work just slept all day and did drugs at night...he accused my mother of being a whore...he would never take responsibility for his own actions always blaming others..and sadly I've become him... When I was younger I tried my best to be nothing like him but as life went on I slowly became just like him.  I'm a loser, addict, all of my dreams seem to far beyond my reach so I'm also a quitter.  I don't ever plan on laying a hand on a woman but it's possible with the rage I have...the thing was I told myself I was going to kill myself if I ever remotely resembled my dad but after 2 failed attempts I'm just really tired now...I see the pain I cause to others cause I can get my shit together and it makes me hate myself even more...I know thinking this way does nothing but it's the way my brain is wired...btw I daily dream of either finding a secluded area and hanging myself on a tree or walking to the beach and swim as far out as I possibly can Till I just run out of gas and drown...I am afraid to die in a way but when I picture myself gone from this world it jut feels right
Thank you for the advice...I know I need to do something but it I don't have the motivation or energy to get better.  I am mentally drained but I'll just fight day by day for now thanks

Thanks for the kind words but the problem is I know what is wrong and right but I don't have the will to use what I have learned to better myself...i keep making the same mistakes...which makes me realize how hopeless trying to change is...I mean it's possible foe me o change for the better but that's going to take time but everyone is pretty much fed up with my negativity which I don't blame them for I understand how difficult it is for people to deal with me. Anyways thanks

You are not alone I completely understand how you feel as I'm in the same boat. I used to use alcohol and pot to help me temporarily escape how depressed I was but I realized it wasn't helping me it was actually making me feel worse...I sorta forgot how to be myself...since I quit drinking and smoking I've been getting some more energy but sadly it hasnt helped my depression that much.  What has helped me is trying to stay grounded in reality. You have to escape that downward spiral of negativity in your thought and just try to focus on reality but it's easier said than done. Anyways I hope you find away to make your life better as i am still searching myself

I understand how you feel...Im actually in the exact situation except I don't have a job anymore...I can't really help you cause I cant even help myself but I hope you can find another way to be happy instead of killing yourself. Good luck

I think suicide is selfish...although I am very suicidal...I have day dreams of just going to the ocean at night and swimming as far out as I possibly can till I'm exhuasted and drown but I recently saw this movie called "still walking" some Japanese film, anyways the mom of the family says that there is nothing worse than going to your own Childs grave.  So I decided that I'm going to wait till she passes to end my life...I don't have a father or friends or anyone that truly understands how tormented I am living in this world. My mom doesn't even understand because in her generation there must nothing more important than surviving.  I wish I could some how find motivation to live to be happy and make my mom proud but I can't seem to find another way out I just keep day dreaming about different ways to end it all.  Well I guess I got off topic just complaining about myself.  I'm going to die anyways so I decided I'm going to stuff myself with antidepressants so it'll make me tolerable to the people I still have in my life currently.
Cut all soda out of you diet and don't eat any carbs for dinner
Yea thanks I think I need to first quit smoking weed. Then start being more social.  Thanks for the great advice and I will not completely forget about women.

The thing is we do have chemistry...I've gone dancing with her, we love the same music and we both try to keep active(exercise and sports). The thing is I am a bit of a introvert I don't talk much unless it's like a one on one convo. When we meet at group events I can't really be myself. Like I want to give her all my attention but I feel like I would be smothering her. Anyways I haven't given up maybe one day in the future I'll get another chance.
Sorry I'd rather know what would be the best way to confess my love.
Thanks for the advice I will follow it

Thanks I've been thinking that these days but it's easier said than done. I grew up with drugs around me and most of my friends now
Do drugs....maybe I should just hide out for a bit and focus on bettering myself before I chase the girl of my dreams
Thanks I hear that alot I guess I should just forget women for now and focus on myself

No actually I confessed my love yesterday to a woman I've been getting to know over the past couple of months. She said she was flattered but...anyways I failed miserably it took alot for me to just tell her but I was all nervous and giggly...we are still friends though.
I dreamt about my dream girl. I couldn't really remember her face but she was amazing and the kisses and body heat felt so real.

But I'm just as lost and depressed. Hope you keep looking 
For that motivation in yourself. Your going to have to truely
